light_description: Analog preamp combining amplifier-style drive, boost and speaker-emulated output functions.
Vintage-style fuzz with rich sustain, harmonic saturation, dynamic cleanup and a selectable frequency character.
Boost pedal that moves from clean level lift into increasingly compressed gain and fuzz-like saturation.
Germanium-based dirt pedal offering touch-sensitive gain and vintage-oriented saturation.
Boutique high-gain drive built around the Dirty Boy sound with a thicker, more saturated character.
Dual-function Dirty Boy dirt design combining gain stages for broader drive control.
Compact all-analog overdrive and preamp adapted from the original Dirty Boy Preamp, with amp simulation and Variac-style sag control.
Compact booster adapted from the Ball Buster circuit, ranging from clean boost to saturated British-style breakup.
Compact fuzz adapted from the Afro Fuzz circuit, offering sustain, harmonic saturation and six-position frequency shaping.
Analog overdrive/distortion ranging from smooth breakup to heavy saturation, with two gain ranges and a wide tone control.
Dual-channel version of the Miesnieks providing a second drive channel alongside the original gain section.
Hand-built fuzz/noise pedal with an intentionally raw, noise-oriented character.
Dynamic overdrive with main-drive, secondary-gain and boost operation, designed for responsive touch and stacking.
Dynamic overdrive built around a flexible gain response with a focused, expressive character.
Handcrafted multi-stage distortion with two gain stages, three clipping options and extensive bass, mid and high-frequency shaping.
Combination gain pedal pairing the Wasp Drive with the Wolf Fuzz in one enclosure.
Centaur-inspired overdrive designed around a broad, harmonic-rich drive response.
Limited-edition Prometheus overdrive presented in a black finish.
Dual overdrive combining the Prometheus and VT 4558 drive sections for blended and independent gain shaping.
Modern high-gain distortion designed for aggressive metal riffing with additional dynamic and tonal shaping.
Octave fuzz designed for an upper-octave-focused, expressive and highly saturated response.
Updated Octagrapher fuzz retaining its octave-oriented saturated character.
Classic-style fuzz with modern dynamics and a vintage-oriented saturated response.
Signal boost/preamp pedal providing substantial level increase for solos or an always-on gain stage.
Transparent overdrive with asymmetrical clipping and strong low-end emphasis for pushing an amplifier.
Silicon fuzz ranging from biting boost-like tones to high-gain saturated fuzz.
Lead fuzz built for creamy, sustained tones that swell into dense saturation.
Germanium-based high-gain dual drive combining overdrive and fuzz in a single pedal.
Distortion with a dedicated Texture control for shaping a dense, decaying and aggressive dirt response.
Handcrafted overdrive using matched NOS germanium clipping diodes, ranging from edge-of-breakup through thick harmonic distortion.
Handcrafted analog fuzz built around a matched two-transistor silicon core with a Chaos Mode and signal meter.
